routes.title: 7 Days Lemosho Route
routes.description: The Lemosho route is widely considered to be the most scenic route on Kilimanjaro, offering panoramic views on various sides of the mountain. It starts with a wild and quiet start in the rainforest before opening up to the literal roof of Africa.

routes.title: 8 Days Lemosho Route
routes.description: The 8-day Lemosho route adds an extra day for acclimatization and offers the same scenery as the 7-day version at a gentler pace.
routes.overview_edit_note: Removed unverified gold-standard-for-success claim and unsupported stunning visual claim; retained itinerary facts.

routes.title: 8 Days Lemosho with Crater Camp
routes.description: Sleep within the ancient volcanic bowl of Kilimanjaro. This elite expedition includes a night at Crater Camp (5730m) near the glaciers.
routes.hero_image_alt: Trekking route: 8 Days Lemosho with Crater Camp

routes.title: 6 Days Machame Route
routes.description: The 'Whiskey Route' is the most popular path on Kilimanjaro. The 6-day version is arduous and fast-paced, suited for fit trekkers with some mountain experience.

routes.title: 7 Days Machame Route
routes.description: The 7-day Machame route includes an extra day at Karanga Valley for essential acclimatization.
routes.overview_edit_note: Removed unverified comparative success-rate claim; retained the source-backed Karanga acclimatization detail.

routes.title: 5 Days Marangu Route
routes.description: The shortest path to the summit via huts. Arduous due to the rapid ascent, the 5-day Marangu is an intense test of willpower and physical fitness.

routes.title: 6 Days Marangu Route
routes.description: The 'Coca-Cola' route is the only one offering hut accommodation. The 6-day version is recommended for its mandatory acclimatization day at Horombo Hut.

routes.title: 3 Days Mount Meru Climb
routes.description: Mount Meru is the perfect warm-up for Kilimanjaro or a stunning stand-alone peak. This 3-day trek is fast-paced but scenically rewarding.
routes.hero_image_alt: Trekking route: 3 Days Mount Meru Climb

routes.title: 4 Days Mount Meru Climb
routes.description: The 4-day Mount Meru itinerary includes an extra day at Saddle Hut for acclimatization before the Socialist Peak summit attempt.
routes.hero_image_alt: Trekking route: 4 Days Mount Meru Climb
routes.overview_edit_note: Removed recommendation and higher-success claims; retained the extra Saddle Hut day and summit objective.

routes.title: 8 Days Northern Circuit
routes.description: A condensed version of the world-class Northern Circuit. Circles the high northern slopes, avoiding the crowds of the southern routes completely.

routes.title: 9 Days Northern Circuit
routes.description: The newest and longest route on Kilimanjaro. It circles nearly the entire mountain, offering incredible 360-degree views and arguably the best acclimatization profile.

routes.title: 9 Days Northern Circuit & Crater
routes.description: The ultimate Kilimanjaro experience. Combines the best-acclimatized route with a night inside the crater. Experience the mountain in its full glory.
routes.hero_image_alt: Trekking route: 9 Days Northern Circuit & Crater

routes.title: 6 Days Rongai Route
routes.description: A direct approach from the north. The 6-day Rongai is a steady climb through varied wilderness, descending via the popular Marangu trail.

routes.title: 7 Days Rongai Route
routes.description: Approaching from the north near the Kenyan border, the Rongai route is drier and less crowded. It transitions from pine forests to cinematic alpine deserts.

routes.title: 6 Days Umbwe Route
routes.description: Short, steep, and hard. The Umbwe route is for experienced climbers only, offering a direct vertical ascent through spectacular terrain.

routes.title: 7 Days Umbwe Route
routes.description: The 7-day variation of the steep Umbwe route offers a slightly improved acclimatization window at Barranco, making the vertical push more manageable.
